# Forge

> Forge is an open-source AI coding agent, editor, and shell unified in one focused, keyboard-driven terminal workspace. Written in Rust. Currently in alpha — review every approval prompt.

Forge keeps the agent, your code, the shell, and every decision in one coherent workspace: no editor hopping, no lost context, no invisible changes. Inspect the code, guide the agent, review each diff, approve commands, and verify the result — all from the keyboard. Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Codex, OpenCode, or local Ollama models, and switch providers from inside Forge.

Built in the open by [Norvia Labs](https://norvialabs.com/).
